TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Action/Analytic.lean: Defines IsEntireAnalytic elements, entireExtension, proves algebraic closure (add, smul, mul, star), group law (entireExtension_add_ofReal, entireExtension_entireExtension), norm bounds, and generator connection.

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CharacterSpaceMeasure.lean: Proves LinearMap.exists_isFiniteMeasure_integral_characterSpace_eq (Riesz-Markov for commutative C*-algebras), integral_apply_star_mul_self, and operator-algebra versions for vector functionals.

TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/Measure.lean: Proves Convex.ae_mem_interior, interior_inter_nonempty_of_addHaar_inter_ne_zero, addHaar_pos_iff_interior_nonempty, ofReal_dist_mul_pow_mul_addHaar_ball_le (volume estimate), and compact convex representative theorem.

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/ContinuousFunctionalCalculus/Continuity.lean: Proves tendsto_cfc_fun_of_finite_spectrum — pointwise convergence on finite spectrum implies functional calculus convergence.

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/ContinuousFunctionalCalculus/Subalgebra.lean: Proves spectral permanence (spectrum_eq_of_predicate) and that closed star subalgebras inherit continuous functional calculus (continuousFunctionalCalculus, coe_cfc).

TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/StdSimplex.lean: Proves convex_range_toFun_comp_weights, card_mul_inf'_smul_add_smul_barycenter (pseudo-radial parameter), and convexJoin_boundary_stdSimplex_barycenter (simplex as join of boundary and barycenter).
TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Hom.lean: Defines StarAlgEquiv.toContinuousLinearEquiv with continuity proofs via isometry.

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/ContinuousFunctionalCalculus/Projection.lean: Proves isStarProjection_cfc (idempotent-valued functions give star projections) and isStarProjection_cfc_indicator (spectral projectors).
TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/FunctionTopology.lean: Proves convexOn_of_tendsto — pointwise limits of eventually convex functions are convex.
TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/ContinuousFunctionalCalculus/Pullback.lean: Proves of_isClosedEmbedding — continuous functional calculus pulls back along unit-reflecting closed embeddings.
TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/SelfAdjointGapInverse.lean: Proves isUnit_and_norm_ringInverse_le — spectral gap implies invertibility with norm bound.
TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/Prod.lean: Proves Convex.preimage_prodMk (fibers are convex) and smul_preimage_prodMk_add_smul_preimage_prodMk_subset (Brunn-Minkowski input).
TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Action/Covariant/Basic.lean: Defines CovariantRepresentation structure, proves ext, group_mul_coefficient, coefficient_action, and trivial construction.
TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/Polyhedron/Basic.lean: Defines IsConvexPolyhedron, proves isClosed, convex, inter, and preimage closure properties.

TauCeti/Analysis/GradientFlow/Slope.lean: Defines descendingSlope, proves descendingSlope_le_of_eventually_le, le_descendingSlope_of_tendsto, IsLocalMin.descendingSlope_eq_zero, Lipschitz slope bounds, and HasFDerivAt.descendingSlope_eq.
TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/Polyhedron/Pi/Basic.lean: Proves isConvexPolyhedron_pi_Icc (coordinate boxes) and isConvexPolyhedron_closedBall_pi (sup-metric balls).

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Action/Involution.lean: Defines twistedInvolution on C_c(G,A), proves twistedInvolution_twistedInvolution (involution), norm_twistedInvolution_apply, support_twistedInvolution.

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Action/Equivariant.lean: Defines IsEquivariant, proves id, comp, zero, comp_action, conjugate, invariant preimage/image/range, and restrict to closed invariant subalgebras.
TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/ClusterSet.lean: Proves isPreconnected_clusterSetOn and isConnected_clusterSetOn (convex domains give pre/connected cluster sets).

TauCeti/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Action/Generator.lean: Defines generator via StronglyContinuousGroup, proves dense_generator_domain, isClosed_generator, hasDerivAt_zero, mem_generator_domain_iff_differentiableAt, generator_mul, generator_star, and generatorDomain as star subalgebra.
TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/FourPoint.lean: Proves add_le_add_of_convexOn_of_add_eq, add_sub_le_add_sub_of_convexOn (Monge four-point inequality), and abs_sub_rpow_add_abs_sub_rpow_le (power costs).

TauCeti/Analysis/Convex/AffineNormalization.lean: Proves IsCompact.exists_affineBasis_abs_coord_le_one (maximal volume simplex), AffineBasis.mem_image_homothety_convexHull_iff, and exists_affineEquiv_ball_subset_image_subset_ball (normalization by balls).

summary: Both files contain substantial original formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, and proofs extending Mathlib's convex analysis library. Gauge.lean adds three gauge-theory lemmas for convex bodies and neighbourhoods. StdSimplex.lean adds four theorems characterizing the standard simplex as convex joins of its boundary/barycentre and facets/vertices, plus a key coordinate-parameter lemma. Neither file is a pure import aggregator (FILTER-007); each contributes unique declarations not represented elsewhere. The prior review (RRV-14148cc454e8-r2) reached the same conclusion for the unit's full file set. Both files satisfy FILTER-004 retention criteria and should remain in the primary index.

summary: All 11 files contain substantial original formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, and proofs extending Mathlib's C*-algebra and convex analysis libraries. The KMS files (Basic.lean, Dense.lean, StateSpace.lean) develop KMS state theory for C*-algebra dynamics with analytic strip functions, dense criteria, and weak-* convexity/compactness results. ApproximateUnit.lean and PositiveLinearFunctional.lean provide norm-preservation and order-theoretic results for positive functionals. The convex sequence files (Gauge.lean, Separation.lean, Basic.lean, Envelope.lean, Order.lean, Vertex.lean) build a complete discrete convex geometry: height sequences, slopes, lower convex envelopes, affine covariance, index translation/reflection, and vertex contact theorems. None are pure import aggregators (FILTER-007); each contributes unique declarations not represented elsewhere. All satisfy FILTER-004 retention criteria.
